question: In a certain code language, 'ARTIST' is written as 'ASTITT' and 'ADVICE' is written as 'AEVIDE'. How will 'ASPECT' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13df3c7bae8c7228feed7c818dc622984b106762d738750acdf022ec2e4eda09.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58d56a870d35f4473a9fe6b3ebe46ae4d55998ecf7511e4ddc0901948581a6ec.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a70462849cf3eeb63cd116a18d3b4655533712b5e765684756e3a56945159fd8.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac914d923a241864a8a320746defe41e042a81c187f43978da4147da87c3977b.png] 

Hence, '**ATPEDT**' is the correct answer.
